notes.constructors: Each constructor contributes {runs_per} runs after whole-cell exclusion. Objectives, internal service constraints and effective search budgets differ. Efficiency averages run-level ratios of total kg to total km. Lost (kg) is mean cumulative discarded mass; time is archived sample elapsed time.
notes.strategies: LM-CF70/LM-CF90 use 70\%/90\% fill thresholds; SL1/SL2 use one-/two-day projections. All five variants share the retained slices. Lost (kg) is mean cumulative discarded mass; time retains the archived clock.
notes.improvers: Pairs match constructor, selector, network and intended demand replay, but not upstream plans. Deltas and win counts are descriptive, not isolated improver effects. Ties are separate; loss is cumulative mass per run.
notes.horizon: The non-factorial 90-day selection rule is unknown. Filtering removes three 90-day rows and six further unmatched rows: $174-3-6=165$. ALNS is absent at 90 days. These pairs neither rank constructors at 90 days nor estimate a population horizon effect.
notes.scenarios: Demand rows use 216 shared policy slices; network rows use 136. Network size and city are confounded. Lost (kg) is mean cumulative discarded mass; time is archived sample elapsed time.
notes.excluded: $D$ denotes horizon; FF 350 is Figueira da Foz. The threshold is a collected-mass shortfall greater than {threshold}\% from the cell median. All three 30-day logs contain 30 records; the 90-day raw log is unavailable. Anomalous tonnage does not establish a crash or truncated logging.
